summary: Delivered the PH-291 cross-domain read-only operations reconciliation overview in the delivery layer. The new `pmo_plugins/delivery/operations_read_services.py` exposes `ops_reconciliation_overview(member, *, as_of=None, period=None)` which aggregates already-delivered owner facts into six sections: contracts (pending changes / terminated contracts / approved lines still active under terminated contracts), settlement (active open items, over-cleared items, refunds, bank returns, refunds without matching clearance, derived remaining balance), management revenue (posted recognitions, reversed recognitions, terminated-still-recognized, recognized vs active-settled net difference), time (pending/confirmed billable confirmations, confirmed minutes, unapproved timesheets), onboarding (PH-274 preview is stateless, so counts/totals are null plus the `import_preview_persistence_not_implemented` missing code instead of 0) and cash (posted transactions, missing classifications, posted in/out/net; for pm the cash section is null plus `cash_not_scoped_to_project`). Role matrix: owner/finance/auditor full, pm limited to managed/visible projects, member denied; history reads survive module disable because the new `modules/delivery/ops-reconciliation-overview/` route is declared `history_read` (appended to an in-memory metadata copy in delivery/urls.py since domain_metadata.py is outside the exact whitelist, so no gate weakening). Everything is deliberately read-only: no writes, no audit, no receipts, no session persistence, no migration, no second insights owner. Tests assert derived (not echoed) values, null-plus-missing semantics, ref cap/truncation, period and as_of filtering, role/scope isolation, invalid-input rejections, module-disabled history, and zero INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE SQL plus unchanged fact/audit/event counts. View/form/template/URL wiring and 15 scoped tests are included; no contract schema or business write path was changed.

deviations: Route wiring: the frozen PH-291 whitelist does not include `pmo_plugins/delivery/domain_metadata.py`, but the SDK requires a declared route for access/dispatch. I appended the `ops_reconciliation_overview` route (`history_read`) to an in-memory copy of DOMAIN_METADATA inside `pmo_plugins/delivery/urls.py` (whitelisted) and bound the handler there; domain_metadata.py and all other files stayed untouched. This keeps the read-only/history semantics without expanding the read/write gate.

The spec's frozen service signature is `ops_reconciliation_overview(member, *, as_of=None)`; per the Lead's explicit requirement I added an optional `period` (YYYY-MM) filter to the service and page. It is additive, read-only and covered by validation/tests; no existing interface was changed.

Onboarding preview section: PH-274's preview is deliberately stateless at this BASE and PH-289 (persistence) is still proposed, so the section reports counts/totals as null plus `import_preview_persistence_not_implemented` rather than fabricating zero; pm cash is likewise null plus `cash_not_scoped_to_project` because cash facts have no project FK.

No audit is written (spec allowed an optional generic audit; the Lead required zero audit), no receipt/session persistence is used, and no migration or contract-schema change was made. The module-disabled page relies on the new history_read route instead of weakening enablement checks.
Refs are capped at 50 per section with an explicit `truncated` flag; the cap is tested with 55 pending changes (refs length 50, truncated true).
